text:
Priya (Finance): Heads up - corporate card chargeback posted on account `redwood-enterprise-42` for $12,400. Dispute reason: "Duplicate/Already Paid" from issuer. Can we gather evidence and decide on provisional credit?
Ethan (Billing): Invoice ID? card last4? processor dispute id?
Priya (Finance): Invoice INV-2026-03-15-324, card ****8452, processor dispute ID: CHG-98765. Invoice PDF: https://billing.redwood.ai/invoices/INV-2026-03-15-324.pdf
PaymentsBot: Chargeback received (CHG-98765). Status: "Under Review". Assigned queue: finance_disputes. Response window: 7 days.
Marta (Risk): @Priya confirm whether we issued a refund/credit. Need subscription snapshot and webhook logs for 15-16 Mar.
Priya (Finance): No credit issued. Snapshot uploaded: gs://redwood-billing/exports/subsnap-INV-324-20260315.csv
Sam (Account Manager): Customer says they paid via wire 2026-03-16. I'll upload treasury receipt.
Ethan (Billing): Querying ledger: SELECT * FROM payments WHERE invoice_id='INV-2026-03-15-324' ORDER BY created_at;
Ethan (Billing): PSP settlement S-20260317-442, descriptor "Redwood Inference Inc.". Txns: pmt_78a9; saw a reversal attempt on 2026-03-18.
Priya (Finance): Uploaded treas-wireremittance-20260316.pdf.
PaymentsBot: Evidence uploaded: treas-wireremittance-20260316.pdf (238KB).
Sam (Account Manager): AP says they referenced our PO instead of remittance code - asking bank for the reference ID.
Marta (Risk): If remittance mismatch, propose provisional credit per playbook v2. Approve provisional credit?
Ethan (Billing): We normally do up to 50% for high-value uncertain disputes.
Priya (Finance): Recommend provisional credit $6,200 (50%).
Sam (Account Manager): Customer agrees to partial credit while they confirm wire. :thumbsup:
Marta (Risk): Approve 50% provisional, contingent on case logging. Assigning risk_case_1142.
Ethan (Billing): Creating provisional credit PC-1142 for $6,200. Memo: "Provisional credit pending wire confirmation for INV-2026-03-15-324 (CHG-98765)"
PaymentsBot: Provisional credit applied to account redwood-enterprise-42. Case created: risk_case_1142.
Priya (Finance): Action items: 1) Ethan: finalize provisional credit + memo 2) Sam: get AP receipt + bank reference 3) Marta: prepare representment packet if wire not found 4) Priya: notify customer and apply credit.
Sam (Account Manager): Messaging customer now, cc finance.
Marta (Risk): Also filing billing backlog task to add clearer remittance code on invoice PDF to reduce PO mismatch.
Priya (Finance): Sounds good. If wire matches, we'll reverse provisional credit and close. If not, proceed with representment. End of thread.
